name: lynq-communication
description: LYNQ Communication: Ultra-fast local-first cross-platform communication platform
author: Vaikundamani L <l.vaikundamani@gmail.com>

scripts.daemon: node -e "import('./packages/network-service/dist/index.js').then(async ({ LynqDaemon }) => { const daemon = new LynqDaemon(); await daemon.start(); console.log('LYNQ Daemon active on ws://localhost:' + daemon.profile.signalingPort); process.on('SIGINT', async () => { await daemon.stop(); process.exit(0); }); });"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/core && npm run build --prefix packages/storage && npm run build --prefix packages/p2p-engine && npm run build --prefix packages/network-service && npm run build --prefix packages/web-ui
